scope: Twelve new date-story Johnny and detached-cap drawings. Appearance candidates only; no approval or native fitting implied.
generation_mode: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; one requested frame per call; four targeted v2 corrections retained with ancestors.

source_exclusion.004: Pure gray ground shadow retained in reference originals and excluded from new-art drawing count.

inspection.000: Alert three-quarter standing pose faces left; far arm down-left, near elbow out-right with hand at waist. Two planted feet and clean transparent background.
inspection.001: Pointing crouch faces left. Extended far arm points left while near elbow bends back/right. Bent separated knees retained.
inspection.002: Deep forward bow. Broad cap top and brim hide both eyes, arms bent outward, knees flexed. No original ground shadow.
inspection.003: Asymmetric airborne jump with bent lifted left-side leg and longer downward right-side leg. v1 head faced right; v2 corrects face, pupils and cap brim toward left while preserving the jump.
inspection.005: One detached cap only, low horizontal side/underside angle. No head or duplicated cap.
inspection.006: Hatless left-facing tucked jump. Exposed shaggy hair, near arm back/up-right, far hand in front, two tightly folded overlapping legs.
inspection.007: One detached cap only, steep upper-left to lower-right angle, black underside and gold band with no invented face.
inspection.008: Hatless left-facing airborne stretch. Raised right-side hand, lower left-side hand, long overlapping bent legs and partly hidden far foot.
inspection.009: Hatless turning jump with a single separated cap above-left. Gaze follows cap, forward hand lifts toward it, opposite arm trails right. Both knees bent.
inspection.010: Right-facing horizontal tumble with one leg folded high and other low. v1 lower leg zigzagged; v2 gives one continuous thigh to knee at left, one shin down-right, and one foot.
inspection.011: Low horizontal right-facing landing. Near arm supports on open palm at lower-right, far arm trails behind. v2 removes misplaced upper-back chest-hair tuft, retaining the valid front-edge tuft and pose.
inspection.012: Rear three-quarter recovery/run faces right and keeps eyes hidden. One planted foot and one lifted back foot. v2 raises the far forearm and fist behind the head to match original, rather than hanging by hip.

validation_limits: Every output visually inspected individually, then all 12 selected candidates composited on light and dark backgrounds with no visible aura. Original diagnostic colors are not material authority. Alpha ranges and edge maximums are pinned in per-output records; native placement and timing deferred.
